title: Equipment Handoff Form
subtitle: Equipment Handoff: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Equipment Handoff Form covers equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation. The equipment custody coordinator records Equipment Handoff activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Equipment Handoff Form keeps Equipment Handoff exceptions visible until the equipment custody coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Equipment Handoff Form at issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point. Document equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation identity before Equipment Handoff begins. Compare equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation findings with stated Equipment Handoff criteria; route unresolved Equipment Handoff issues to asset-control reviewer. For Equipment Handoff Form, confirm requirements for Equipment Handoff. Ask asset-control reviewer to review Equipment Handoff conditions beyond the equipment custody coordinator's role.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Equipment Handoff, identify responsible parties, issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point, and the linked equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, serial, model, and quantity
Accessory, key, credential, software, and configuration identifiers

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Equipment Handoff facts for equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Equipment Handoff operating checks
items: Custody date, location, and intended use
Return condition, due date, and unresolved defect

sections.title: Operating exception, outcome, and review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Equipment Handoff conditions; have equipment custody coordinator assign the next Equipment Handoff owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe or failed equipment cannot be released
blocks.guidance: Pause Equipment Handoff when authority, identity, condition, data protection, accessory accounting, or custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Equipment Handoff proof and route unresolved equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope to equipment custody coordinator.
